name: Four Seasons Apart
source:
Follow the story of Andrew, an orphaned fox living in the countryside of Victorian Britain as his world expands before him. It all begins with the return of Dylan, his childhood friend—and secret lover—from the English capital. This happy occasion is turned on its head as both wonder if they have changed too much years they have been apart.

Spanning multiple locations and years. This romantic story features drama, romance, and sensual moments as the main characters navigate new and old emotions.

[From [url=https://cardigan-cardigan.itch.io/four-seasons-apart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随生活在维多利亚时代英国乡间的狐狸孤儿安德鲁，见证他眼前的世界徐徐展开。一切都始于他的竹马好友——兼秘密恋人——迪伦从英国首都归来。然而，这场久别重逢的喜事却陡生波澜：两人都不禁怀疑，阔别经年，彼此是否都已改变太多。

故事横跨数载光阴，辗转多处舞台。在这段融汇戏剧冲突、浪漫情愫与缠绵时刻的恋曲中，主角们将在新旧交织的情感间摸索前行。

[摘自[url=https://cardigan-cardigan.itch.io/four-seasons-apart]itch.io[/url]]
